fact_verdicts.note: Page is the EPA profile for George Air Force Base, Victorville CA (id 0902737): 'development of an international airport and railway hub'; business park reuse 'on hold due to economic conditions'. No date on page.

Same George AFB profile: 'home to 17 aviation-related businesses', aircraft mechanics program, 'multi-million dollar power plant and a 900-acre federal prison complex'. Undated; existing uses as the fact says.

EPA profile for Jacksonville Ash Site, 1093 West 6th Street, Jacksonville FL 32209: 'Future redevelopment is being planned for the Lonnie Miller Park area'; sports complex with soccer fields, baseball diamonds, basketball courts. No date or timeline.

Dec 19, 2024 News4JAX story by Aaron Farrar republished on Jacksonville Today: park in NW Jacksonville used for incinerator ash; 'goal is to get the contaminated ash site cleaned up by the summer of 2025'. Park name matches the EPA profile's Lonnie Miller Park area.

Dec 20, 2024: residents frustrated ('After all of these years, why now?'); 'cleanup ... expected to take about a year'; 'Phase two, which includes park remodeling, is projected to cost over $12 million.'
Mar 15, 2026: 'The city divided the project into two phases to allow part of the park to reopen sooner.' City-run project; page gives no street address, ties to the park only by name.

'remediation costs totaling more than $22 million'; plans include athletic fields, trails, pavilion space, parking; finish expected by end of 2026 (city Solid Waste Division). Summary says $22M covers ash removal and upgrades; page calls it remediation costs.
